notes: Modified cash basis village with governmental and proprietary (garbage, electric, water, sewer, utility deposit) funds. Governmental lines from p4 Total Governmental Funds column; beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances on p4 (544,063 and 570,181; balance sheet p3 shows cash 601,212 less 31,031 due to fire department). 'Other general receipts' 160,111 split using the p9 General Fund departmental breakdown (155,037) plus residual 5,074 (Special Revenue Fund column p4). Business-type lines from the p6 proprietary Total column; no single printed total, so reported business totals are operating total plus non-operating items (computed). Non-operating bond principal and interest recorded as disbursements; non-operating receipts include negative miscellaneous (349). Net position statement p1 lists 'Restricted for cemetery perpetual' as a wrapped label with Street 45,974 beside it; recorded as Restricted: Street (matches p3). Detail: used the more detailed p9-10 Departmental Analysis of General Fund (columns General, Fire, Park are departments; Debt service column holds only a 4,633 presentation-change 'Transfers In'); from the p7-8 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis only the business-type disbursement lines (p8: Electric, Solid Waste, Sewer, Water; operating expenses as 'not itemized', Sewer debt service 46,380 not split, marked review) were recorded, tying to the printed Total Business-type activities 622,391 (budget 1,030,000); its governmental disbursements duplicate the p9-10 departmental analysis and its p7 receipts are primary-government combined (not split by fund type), so neither was recorded to avoid double counting. Page 9 columns re-derived and verified against column totals. Read pages 1-10 of 10 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) added for the funds that had no schedule. The General Fund departmental analysis lines (p9-10) are kept (they tie to the General Fund column); its Debt service 'Transfers In' 4,633 line is removed (on the governmental funds statement it is the change in fund presentation of beginning balances, not a transfer, and top-level transfers are null). The business-type budget-schedule lines (p8) are replaced by the proprietary statement lines.

report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Activities (p2) shows Sewer disbursements 55,669 and business-type total 622,791 (primary government 1,108,352); the proprietary statement (p6: 8,889 + 46,380 = 55,269) and budget schedule (p8: 622,391; total 1,107,952) are 400 lower. p2 offsets it with business-type other general receipts 621 vs 221 net non-operating on p6 (570 - 349), so the change in net position (149,030) agrees. p6 used.

decision_needed.question: Sales tax collected on utility bills (p6, 25,443; 23,824 remitted as a disbursement) is a pass-through of state sales tax, not village sales tax revenue. Keep as business-type "other" or recategorise as sales tax?
